finalMessage:
Implemented the complete Orbitarium static site.

- 3D interactive solar system with propagated planet and 42k NEO positions
- Time scrubbing, playback, speeds, camera drag/zoom
- Search, hazardous/Sentry filters, orbit extent control
- Object details, Sentry risk and close-approach data, follow mode
- Optional comet overlay and shareable URL view state
- Fully self-contained relative runtime fetches from built `dist/data/`

Build verified with `pnpm build`; output is in [dist](/Users/mikevalstar/projects/nbench/2026-07-09-18-32-19-chatgpt-gpt-5-6-terra-high/dist). Main sources: [app.js](/Users/mikevalstar/projects/nbench/2026-07-09-18-32-19-chatgpt-gpt-5-6-terra-high/src/app.js), [style.css](/Users/mikevalstar/projects/nbench/2026-07-09-18-32-19-chatgpt-gpt-5-6-terra-high/src/style.css).
